dataset.description:
This is a preliminary template describing a dataset to be prepared for the duration of the 
doctoral grant. The dataset is going to comprise the input data used and results of analysis, 
and the economic assessment for an optimal BESS state of charge management methodology for use in the electricity and ancillary service markets.

distribution.title:
Data will be collected and generated to perform and present the technical and economic 
assessment of BESS state of charge management methodology for use in the electricity and
ancillary service markets.
